Clear data visualization and stakeholder communication

action_plan.action: Rebuild a Tableau project in Power BI. Practice relationships, measures, and interactive filters around a business question.

action_plan.action: Turn your SQL transformations into dbt models. Add basic data quality tests and document the model dependencies.
action_plan.deliverable: A small, tested transformation project feeding your dashboard.
